data.title: bn-3ohe: PR-15 network pack profile (delivery/drop/duplicate/delay/partition) and the GOV-4-13 host-conformance not-applicable form

data.body: [HIGH][CWE-807] The GOV-4-13 not-applicable gate trusts a regex hit as proof of a real fidelity profile. `host_qualifications` accepts every textual `host: HostQualification::<word>` under `src/`, and lines 297-304 treat any nonempty all-None list as authoritative. The shared comment stripper at tools/governance/check_code_policy.py:243-296 preserves ordinary and raw string contents. Therefore a crate with no profile can add an inert string containing `host: HostQualification::None`; a host-qualified profile can also use an alias, qualified path, macro, or cfg-selected expression while leaving that decoy. The new fixtures cover only direct `Measured` syntax and total absence, so the bypass reports clean and waives mandatory host/Lab conformance. Failure modes: inert text, unrelated structs, dead cfg blocks, and alternate Rust spellings forge the waiver. Edge cases: macros, aliases, fully qualified paths, multiple profiles, and cfg-specific profiles are ambiguous or invisible. Rollback: remove the waiver path until a structured source of truth exists, or require a machine-readable profile manifest whose identity is checked against compiled pack metadata. Monitoring: make every unmatched or ambiguous profile declaration a CI violation and report the resolved profile count. Validation: add negative fixtures for a string decoy with no profile, a decoy plus an aliased host qualification, dead cfg code, macro expansion, and multiple profile modules; each must fail while the current real None profile remains clean.

[HIGH][CWE-400] Accepted payload bytes have no cumulative memory budget. `MAX_PAYLOAD_CAP` is 65536 and `MAX_STEPS` is 1048576 at step.rs:15-19, while every Send clones its payload into an event and Deliver only removes the in-flight copy. Alternating a maximum-size Send and Deliver keeps `in_flight` at one yet retains 524288 payloads, exactly 32 GiB before enum and allocator overhead, without any typed refusal. The direct `Network::apply` API creates this incrementally, so the caller need not preallocate a large log. `journal()` at lines 98-104 clones the history, and `choice_log` plus `replay` at lines 488-502 can hold several full payload copies and exceed 64 GiB. Failure modes: process OOM, allocator abort, or host-wide pressure replaces the promised typed ResourceExhausted outcome. Edge cases: low in-flight bounds do not help; zero-copy delivery does not free history; replay, encoding, and snapshot clones amplify memory. Rollback: cap cumulative retained payload and journal bytes before cloning, return a typed bound refusal, and thread the budget through direct apply, run, journal, replay, and encode paths. Monitoring: expose retained-byte spend and refusal counts against the configured budget. Validation: use tiny deterministic limits to test the exact boundary, one byte over, repeated send/deliver with in-flight one, journal cloning, replay, and encoding without large allocations.

[HIGH][CWE-693] The new INV-015 no-host-path proof is a substring scan that can miss safe-Rust host effects. `host_effect_lines` at lines 348-375 checks only a short spelling list. For example, an existing method can import `std::{os::unix::net::UnixDatagram as U}` and call `U::unbound()` without matching `std::os`, `std::net`, `TcpStream`, or any listed token. This changes no public item, adds no dependency or build script, and keeps continuumd unlinked, so all four asserted audit legs still pass although the Lab pack now executes a host socket effect. Failure modes: a host network, filesystem, process, or environment effect lands under an unlisted or aliased API while evidence still states no host path. Edge cases: grouped imports, renames, reexports, fully qualified traits, platform-specific modules, and calls hidden in macros defeat substring inventories. Rollback: do not use this test as evidence of absence; enforce a capability/dependency boundary with compiler-resolved imports or a complete deny policy over the pack, and keep the profile waiver blocked until that control is authoritative. Monitoring: emit the compiler-resolved external-call and dependency closure for every pack change. Validation: mutation tests must add aliased UnixDatagram, grouped fs imports, process/environment access, and macro-expanded calls inside existing public methods and prove every case fails the gate.

data.reason: Three unresolved HIGH findings: GOV-4-13 host-conformance waiver forgery, cumulative journal-payload memory exhaustion, and a bypassable INV-015 no-host-effect proof. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.body: [RESOLVED][HIGH] Target 26e31795 bounds each journal canonical encoding with max_retained_bytes, caps that budget at 256 MiB, charges the exact next event before any state mutation, keeps each payload only in its Sent event, makes choice_log lazy, and replays one step at a time. lab.rs:61-83, 228-279, 342-359, 489-507, 559-590 and step.rs:18-23, 115-160 close the incremental 32 GiB path.

The INV-015 gate closes cfg, macro, include, raw-token, extern-crate, feature, target-dependency, build-script, and lane-disable escapes at inv015_agent_least_authority_evidence.rs:345-470 and 1650-1751.

data.reason: Resolved at 26e31795 by structural no_std authority closure plus live profile and compiler-lane evidence.

[HIGH RISK REVIEW] Failure modes: the retained-byte budget closes incremental journal amplification, no_std closure removes host authority, and typed refusals prevent unsupported semantics from becoming success. Edge cases: exact and one-byte-short budgets, in-flight-one churn, FIFO duplicates, 64-node partitions, replay, cfg, raw-token, extern-crate, feature, dependency, build-script, and dead-test escapes were inspected. Rollback: revert the unmerged three-commit range; profile 0.1.0 has no mainline consumer. Monitoring: retained_bytes and Bound::Retained expose budget spend, while GOV-4-13 and INV-015 fail closed on authority drift; no production host path exists. Validation: reviewed the whole persisted range daa0d34d..26e31795 and inspected its source tests and fixtures; tests were not executed because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata. No static blocker remains. This LGTM does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
